note: recordings/*.jsonl are full ACP transcripts (acp-recording/1: both pipes, every line, in order, with direction and time), captured 2026-09-24 (Claude Code, Codex) and 2026-09-25 (Copilot, capture window 2) through tools/acp_record.py; replay_agent.py replays them verbatim, with no synthesised message (D5). The *-prompt-response.json files are session/prompt results only, from the 2026-09-23 spikes (read by tests/test_telemetry.py); the spikes' other probe outputs were deleted (docs/notes/spike-phase1-probes.md). 'unknown' means not recorded anywhere found (git history from b82d28b, the spike notes); it is never a guess. Kept on purpose: the Claude Code recordings' available_commands_update lists the operator's user-level command names inside a cell whose CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is isolated. That is US-13 evidence of known class R1.4 (account-level context survives isolation), so the scrub keeps it. Removed on purpose: the account plan and tier labels in _auth/status_update are <PLAN> (data minimisation; no test needs them).
